brussels-eifel-and-high-fens-day.title: Brussels · Eifel and High Fens Day
brussels-eifel-and-high-fens-day.slogan: Moorland, border roads and small-town stops.
brussels-eifel-and-high-fens-day.story: Moorland, border roads and small-town stops. A 321 km loop that starts and ends near Spa, about 5 h 32 of riding. On the way it passes High Fens roads, Monschau old town and Eupen  roads. It crosses from Belgium into Germany - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. Back roads rather than main roads, where the map allows.

places-cingle-del-puig-barranc-de-la-fal.story: From Ares del Maestre it runs 411 km to Ares del Maestre; allow about 7 h 05 of riding. It goes by way of Cova de Gargán, Castell de Villafamés, Peñón de Santo Espíritu and Barranc de la falaguera- Abric I. The highest point is about 1,200 m. The line favours views over speed.
